pages.title: What to bring home
pages.text: A Trial Chamber supplies all four materials this mod runs on.$(li)$(thing)Breeze Rods$() drop from Breezes.$(li)$(thing)Breeze Shards$() are in supply chests and corridor pots.$(li)$(thing)Breeze Crystals$() come from ordinary vaults.$(li)$(thing)Heavy Cores$() come from ominous vaults.

pages.title: Breeze Shard
pages.text: The workhorse. Shards repair both the detector and the goggles, 250 durability at a time in an anvil, so you will keep needing them long after the first raid.$(br2)Expect roughly eight to eleven from a full chamber.

pages.title: Breeze Crystals
pages.text: The lens material. Two of them make one pair of goggles and that is the only thing they are for, so a single chamber is enough.$(br2)Vaults only. Breezes never drop them.

pages.title: Heavy Core
pages.text: Vanilla's own ominous vault drop, and the hard gate on this mod. The detector takes $(thing)two$(), so a detector is a real expedition rather than an afternoon.
